newsitem.title: USA: Chase to launch $1.0 billion loan for Sinclair.
newsitem.headline: Chase to launch $1.0 billion loan for Sinclair.

text.p: NEW YORK, April 24 (LPC) - Chase Manhattan Corp is getting ready to launch a $1.0 billion syndicated loan that refinances an existing deal for Sinclair Broadcast Group, market sources said.
The new loan drops pricing and eliminates the B term loan from a 1996 credit for the company, according to bankers.
The new, 7.5-year loan is split between a $400 million revolver and a $600 million term loan, a number of sources said.
A portion of the deal is being syndicated solely to banks, the remaining portion to institutions, abanker said.
Pricing on the earlier deal started at 250 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR), but has since been reduced to 225 basis points over LIBOR, sources said.

The credit was split between a $250 million, 7.5-year revolving credit; a $550 million, 6.6-year A term loan; and a $200 million, 7.5-year B term loan that carried starting pricing of 275 basis points over LIBOR.
Sinclair Broadcast Group owns and/or provides programming services to more than 28 television stations in 20 markets.
